queries.dax:
// note: quartiles of customers' 2023 sales by country with PERCENTILEX.EXC over every customer of the country, those without 2023 sales giving a blank value, and how many customers sit above their country's third quartile (a DAX error: k must lie in 1/(N+1)..N/(N+1))
// expect: error
EVALUATE
SUMMARIZECOLUMNS(
    Customer[Country],
    TREATAS({ 2023 }, 'Date'[Year]),
    "Customers", [Customers],
    "P25", PERCENTILEX.EXC(VALUES(Customer[CustomerKey]), [Sales Amount], 0.25),
    "P75", PERCENTILEX.EXC(VALUES(Customer[CustomerKey]), [Sales Amount], 0.75),
    "Above P75",
        VAR p = PERCENTILEX.EXC(VALUES(Customer[CustomerKey]), [Sales Amount], 0.75)
        RETURN COUNTROWS(FILTER(VALUES(Customer[CustomerKey]), [Sales Amount] > p))
)
ORDER BY Customer[Country]
